text.p: Italian striker Fabrizio Ravanelli failed to report for training at Middlesbrough on Thursday even though he is still contracted to the English first division side.
Ravanelli said he would not play for Middlesbrough after they were relegated and is currently the subject of transfer speculation along with the club's Brazilian midfielder Juninho.

"We granted Juninho permission (to miss training) under family circumstances. The situation was different with Ravanelli, and it is an internal matter within the club," said Middlesbrough spokesman Adrian Bevington.
Ravanelli, who has three years to run on his contract, now faces disciplinary action. The club could fine him and even suspend him if he fails to explain his absence.
Liverpool and Everton, along with Borussia Dortmund, are all reportedly interested in signing him.
